The '''anti-isolationist movement''' was a faction of people on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]] who were against the planet's isolation and believed that exploration and trade with other systems would be helpful for Kegan. [[V-Nen]] and [[O-Melie]] were two members of this group.
